006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import java.util.Objects;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.IDataTypeAdapter;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * An abstract implementation of an atomic type backed by a data type adapter.
017 *
018 * @param <T>
019 *          the Java type of the item supported by the implementation
020 */
021public class DataTypeItemType<T extends IAnyAtomicItem>
022    extends AbstractAtomicOrUnionType<T> {
023  @NonNull
024  private final IDataTypeAdapter<?> adapter;
025
026  /**
027   * Construct a new atomic type.
028   *
029   * @param adapter
030   *          the data type adapter supporting the item type
031   * @param itemClass
032   *          the item class this atomic type supports
033   * @param castExecutor
034   *          the executor used to cast an item to an item of this type
035   */
036  public DataTypeItemType(
037      @NonNull IDataTypeAdapter<?> adapter,
038      @NonNull Class<T> itemClass,
039      @NonNull ICastExecutor<T> castExecutor) {
040    super(itemClass, castExecutor);
041    this.adapter = adapter;
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the data type adapter associated with this type.
046   *
047   * @return the adapter
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  public IDataTypeAdapter<?> getAdapter() {
051    return adapter;
052  }
053
054  @Override
055  public IEnhancedQName getQName() {
056    return getAdapter().getPreferredName();
057  }
058
059  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
060  @Override
061  public T newItem(Object value) {
062    return (T) getAdapter().newItem(value);
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  public String toString() {
067    return toSignature();
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  public int hashCode() {
072    return Objects.hash(adapter, getItemClass());
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
077    if (this == obj) {
078      return true;
079    }
080    if (!(obj instanceof DataTypeItemType)) {
081      return false;
082    }
083    DataTypeItemType<?> other = (DataTypeItemType<?>) obj;
084    return Objects.equals(getAdapter(), other.getAdapter())
085        && Objects.equals(getItemClass(), other.getItemClass());
086  }
087}
